blocks.text: You can manually trigger a playbook to run a series of actions outside of automated runs. In Agentic SOC, you can manually trigger playbooks on an incident or alert.
To trigger a playbook on an incident:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC.
In the left-side navigation, click Incidents.
The Incidents page appears.
Click the incident you want to trigger a playbook on.
The Incident Detail page opens.
On the Incident Detail page, click Select Playbook at the top of the page or in the AI Response Actions section.
See image.
The Response Action drawer opens.
The Response Action drawer only lists playbooks applicable to the Incident entity type. To create a new playbook, click Create Playbook.
In the Response Action drawer:
Select the playbook you want to run, review its summary, and click Continue.
See image.
Select the actions you want to include in the playbook run. For actions that require a target, select the applicable target entity.
See image.
Click Trigger Playbook.
View the playbook's run to verify that all actions were successful.
